comparison.objective: Feed a laminating pouch sealed-edge-first and square, then release it to the rollers; candidate commissions a damper.
comparison.physical_skill: Thin-sheet orientation and controlled feed/release versus precision key engagement, fine rotary tuning and lock-force control.
comparison.success_condition: Correct first bite, acceptable skew and completed feed without a held-pouch jam versus repeatable bounded carriage deceleration and retained setting.
comparison.reason: Feed orientation and handoff to rollers are different from mechanical adjustment, despite generic alignment. Candidate rebound, overload and drift criteria remain unquantified.
